## Change

What problem does this solve, and what behavior changes? Link the issue.

## Validation

Checks run and results; include a regression case and any checks not run.

## Compatibility and rollout

Dependencies, migrations, release notes, or deployment order; write None when
there are none. Note changes to approvals, credentials, permissions, retention,
or execution outcomes when applicable. Report vulnerabilities privately first.

- [ ] Public text, fixtures, logs, and screenshots contain no secrets or customer data.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated; Unreleased notes added when needed.
- [ ] Requested changes are addressed; a maintainer must review the final revision.
